# Name resolution

[`getaddrinfo`](/docs/api/linux/resolve#getaddrinfo) and the list of addresses it returns.

<h2 id="address-info"><code>AddressInfo</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct AddressInfo {
    pub flags: int32;
    pub family: int32;
    pub socketType: int32;
    pub protocol: int32;
    pub addressLength: uint32;
    pub address: *opaque;
    pub canonicalName: *char8;
    pub next: *var AddressInfo;
}
```

The C library's `addrinfo`: one result of [`getaddrinfo`](/docs/api/linux/resolve#getaddrinfo), linked to the next.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Resolve.rux#L10)

**Fields**

| Name            | Type               | Description                              |
| --------------- | ------------------ | ---------------------------------------- |
| `flags`         | `int32`            | Flags such as `AI_PASSIVE`.              |
| `family`        | `int32`            | The address family, or zero for any.     |
| `socketType`    | `int32`            | The socket type, or zero for any.        |
| `protocol`      | `int32`            | The protocol, or zero for any.           |
| `addressLength` | `uint32`           | The size of `address` in bytes.          |
| `address`       | `*opaque`          | The address, a `sockaddr`.               |
| `canonicalName` | `*char8`           | The host's canonical name, or null.      |
| `next`          | `*var AddressInfo` | The next result, or null after the last. |

<h2 id="getaddrinfo"><code>getaddrinfo</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func getaddrinfo(
    node: *char8,
    service: *char8,
    hints: *AddressInfo,
    result: *var *var AddressInfo
) -> int32
```

Looks up the addresses of a host and service.

**See also**: [https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man3/getaddrinfo.3.html](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man3/getaddrinfo.3.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Resolve.rux#L39)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type                    | Description                                                                                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `node`    | `*char8`                | the host name or numeric address, NUL-terminated, or null                                    |
| `service` | `*char8`                | the service name or port number, NUL-terminated, or null                                     |
| `hints`   | `*AddressInfo`          | what kind of results are wanted, or null for every kind                                      |
| `result`  | `*var *var AddressInfo` | receives the first result, freed with [`freeaddrinfo`](/docs/api/linux/resolve#freeaddrinfo) |

**Returns**: zero, or an `EAI_*` code

<h2 id="freeaddrinfo"><code>freeaddrinfo</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func freeaddrinfo(info: *var AddressInfo)
```

Frees the results of [`getaddrinfo`](/docs/api/linux/resolve#getaddrinfo).

**See also**: [https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man3/freeaddrinfo.3.html](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man3/freeaddrinfo.3.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Resolve.rux#L45)

**Parameters**

| Name   | Type               | Description      |
| ------ | ------------------ | ---------------- |
| `info` | `*var AddressInfo` | the first result |
